hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Employ two boundary pointers converging from left and right ends.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: When the pair sum exceeds limit decrement right, otherwise update maximal sum and advance left.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def maxValidPairSum(nums: list[int], limit: int) -> int:
    nums.sort()
    left = 0
    right = len(nums) - 1
    best = -1
    while left < right:
        s = nums[left] + nums[right]
        if s <= limit:
            best = max(best, s)
            left += 1
        else:
            right -= 1
    return best
```

complexity.notes: Sorting dominates linear two pointer scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all pairs without sorting scales as O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorts in place without allocating extra structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard two-pointer bounded pair search.
